title: Spanish Greetings 101

title: Understanding Percentages
description: Quick mental math for everyday life.
text: A percentage is a fraction of 100. To find 20% of 50: multiply 50 × 0.20 = 10. To calculate a tip, move the decimal one place left (10%) and double it for 20%. Percentages appear in discounts, taxes, and statistics daily.
